notes.title: Ophelia’s Chapter – Playthrough + Developer Q&A #2
notes.content:
Ophelia’s Chapter is a story-rich, psychological-horror adventure game where you play as an urban witch with psychic abilities and delve into the mysteries of a world inspired by the work of Neil Gaiman and Stephen King.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2457500/Ophelias_Chapter/

Let’s play the demo and chat 
Join us playing the game while discussing some of the mysteries and the lore of The Keys to the White Pillar series. Get to know about similar games we love, our sources of inspiration and our influences.

Send us your Questions live!
We’d love you to send us your questions via chat so we can have a meaningful conversation and find out more about the game or the team members.

Have a sneak peek of what we’ve been working on
It’s your chance to get a glimpse of some of the haunted-surreal backgrounds and characters we’ve been working on lately, as well as new locations that do not appear on the demo.

Thanks for the support, please Wishlist the game ;)

[previewyoutube=p-Sqy2i0Exc;full][/previewyoutube]
